purpose: Single source of truth for every quantified claim used on a resume. experience.json and projects.json carry the prose; they cite entries here by evidence key instead of restating numbers. If a number appears in two places, this file wins.

verification_levels.external: Confirmed against an external system (GitHub API/CLI, npm registry, app store listing). Safe to print.
verification_levels.self_asserted: Recorded by Ayush in his own notes. Plausible and usable, but he is the only source. Do not present as measured.
verification_levels.rejected: Appeared in a source document but is provably wrong or misattributed. Never print. Retained here so it does not get reintroduced.

gh.profile.note: data/github/summary.md says 19 followers. It is the sole outlier against three agreeing sources; treat as stale.

hf.authored_commits.note: This is the ONLY defensible personal commit total for HealthFlex. See rejected.hf.commit_misattribution.

hf.merged_prs_total.note: Strongest aggregate in the dataset. Prefer this over any commit count when a single headline number is needed.

scannergo.installs.phrasing_rule: Write 'contributed to Scanner Go (10M+ Play Store installs)' as a Flutter developer over ~4 months. NEVER write 'built an app with 10M downloads'. Ayush's own notes flag this figure: 'Confirm before quoting: verify the exact download/scale figure' and 'Don't say: inflated user numbers you can't defend.'

hf.commit_misattribution.reason: 582 is the contributor-table total for GitHub user 'nirajgeorgian'; 483 is 'nirajgeorgianflex'. These are other people's commit counts, lifted from a repo contributor table and written up as Ayush's own work. The 1,800+ aggregate compounds the error.
hf.commit_misattribution.correct: Use hf.authored_commits (473 total: 370 / 79 / 24) or, better, hf.merged_prs_total (91 merged PRs).
hf.commit_misattribution.found_in: data/resume/experience.json (HealthFlex highlights), data/resume/projects.json (HealthFlex API), Notion Areas/HealthFlex.md

gh.recent_commits_as_totals.reason: activity.json 'recent_commits' is a capped API window, not a total. It takes only the values {0,1,2,3,4,5,10} across 23 repos and eight repos sit at exactly 10. Reading the ceiling as a floor ('10+') inverts its meaning. Summing it produces a meaningless number.
gh.recent_commits_as_totals.correct: No year-level commit or PR total is supported by the data on disk. Omit, or use hf.merged_prs_total.

gh.summary_md.reason: data/github/summary.md disagrees with index.json, github/profile.json and resume/skills.json, which all agree with each other. It is a stale generated artifact.

cross_wired_people.reason: None of these are Ayush's. The first two belong to Anshuman Patel (a Snabbit interviewer whose notes are in the Notion export). The third is an interviewer's system-design prompt. The fourth is Notion's stock OKR template sample data.

education.cgpa_template_contamination.reason: education.json says CGPA 7.96/10, which is byte-identical to the value in data/.old/main.tex - Ashish Pratap Singh's resume, used as the LaTeX template. Both FlowCV resumes say 7.98/10.
education.cgpa_template_contamination.status: Ayush reviewed this on 2026-07-09 and kept 7.96. Retained as a note, not a correction.
